comment: TS relationship to cross-cutting semantic governance — Section 3.4.5, printed pp. 57–58 (PDF 68–69), distinguishes governance from runtime services and gives governance a cross-registry scope. The two services should not be equated with the whole governance capability. The wording avoids treating the LIMR as exclusively a runtime tool.

public.suggestedRevision: Replace that sentence only: Together, the TS and the LIMR provide technical services through which governed semantic content is made available; they operate within the broader cross-cutting Semantic Governance Infrastructure described in section 3.4.5.
